subject: Asterion Health onramp: MAP draft + workshop slide stub
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@asterionhealth.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@asterionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Asterion Health onramp: MAP draft + workshop slide stub

Hi Elena and Tom,

Thanks again for the time earlier — great discussion on measurable success for the pilot. Attached is a starter MAP template tuned for a 6-week pilot and a 2-slide kickoff deck we use to align stakeholders quickly. The MAP focuses on the technical acceptance criteria we discussed (latency targets, sample throughput, and privacy constraints) and a short set of business outcomes for the trial.

What I'm proposing:
- We share this MAP as a collaborative Google Doc and iterate it in a short workshop (60 minutes) next week.
- During the workshop we'll align stakeholders, confirm data access plan, and lock the acceptance tests.
- Post-workshop, Redwood will turn the MAP into an execution plan with owners and dates.

Links/attachments: 
- Starter MAP template (attached): Asterion_MAP_template_v1.gdoc
- Kickoff slides (attached): onramp-slide-deck-stub.pptx
- Live draft (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cAsterionMAPedit

Can you share preferred times for a 60-minute alignment session next week (Jan 12–14)? I can run the session and Marissa will take notes and own the follow-up MAP edits.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@asterionhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Asterion Health onramp: MAP draft + workshop slide stub

Jonas — thanks, this looks useful. Quick notes from our side:

- Tom (cc'd) will own security and KMS questions; he asked whether the MAP template can surface an explicit audit-log acceptance test.
- Our legal team wants to see an estimated data retention/flow section added before we run any demos with production data.
- For timing, Jan 13 at 2pm PT works for our core group (Tom, myself, and one engineer). If you need a longer slot let us know.

Can Marissa include an acceptance-test checklist in the doc that maps to the items Tom will bring up? If we can get that in the live doc before the workshop, it'll speed things up.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Integrations, Asterion Health
elena.ruiz@asterionhealth.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@asterionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Asterion Health onramp: MAP draft + workshop slide stub

Thanks Elena — Jan 13 2pm PT is locked on my calendar. I've gone ahead and added an acceptance-test checklist section to the live draft and seeded three audit-log checks under Security > Acceptance tests. Marissa also added a short data-retention summary under Compliance (please review and flag anything missing).

Quick summary of edits I made in the doc (live link below):
- New section: "Acceptance tests (security & audit)" with 3 items and owners
- New section: "Data retention & flow" with recommended retention windows and masked-demo guidance
- Timeline: expanded the pilot plan to show a 4-week technical validation window + 2-week acceptance window

Live draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cAsterionMAPedit
Attachments (in case you want a local copy): Asterion_MAP_template_v1.gdoc, onramp-slide-deck-stub.pptx

Agenda for the Jan 13 workshop (60 minutes):
0) 5 min intro & success metrics (Jonas)
1) 15 min technical readiness review (Tom + engineer)
2) 15 min acceptance tests & security requirements (Tom + Marissa)
3) 15 min timeline & owners (all)
4) 10 min next steps & risks (all)

If you want me to add a slide that calls out the fallback model/latency targets, I can drop that into the deck this afternoon.

See you tomorrow — I'll run the session.

Jonas

From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@asterionhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@asterionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Asterion Health onramp: MAP draft + workshop slide stub

Jonas/Elena — thanks for the quick turn. The acceptance-test checklist looks good. A few small asks from security before we finalize:

- Can Redwood add a short entry indicating expected log retention location (S3 vs. vendor log service) and the encryption-at-rest status?
- For the masked-demo guidance, can you include a short example dataset (anonymized) we can use for the first validation run?

I'll bring up the KMS/rotation cadence during the workshop. See you at 2pm PT.

Tom
Tom Becker
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform | Asterion Health
tom.becker@asterionhealth.com
